candidates.formal_type:
∀ {k : Type u_1} [inst : Field.{u_1} k] {V : Type u_2} {W : Type u_3} {U : Type u_4} [inst_1 : AddCommGroup.{u_2} V]
  [inst_2 : Module.{u_1, u_2} k V] [inst_3 : AddCommGroup.{u_3} W] [inst_4 : Module.{u_1, u_3} k W]
  [inst_5 : AddCommGroup.{u_4} U] [inst_6 : Module.{u_1, u_4} k U],
  Exists.{max (max (u_2 + 1) (u_3 + 1)) (u_4 + 1)} fun e =>
    ∀
      (f :
        LinearMap.{u_1, u_1, u_2, max u_4 u_3} (RingHom.id.{u_1} k) V
          (LinearMap.{u_1, u_1, u_3, u_4} (RingHom.id.{u_1} k) W U))
      (v : V) (w : W),
      Eq.{u_4 + 1}
        (DFunLike.coe.{max (max (u_2 + 1) (u_3 + 1)) (u_4 + 1), max (u_2 + 1) (u_3 + 1), u_4 + 1}
          (DFunLike.coe.{max (max (u_2 + 1) (u_3 + 1)) (u_4 + 1), max (max (u_2 + 1) (u_3 + 1)) (u_4 + 1),
              max (max (u_2 + 1) (u_3 + 1)) (u_4 + 1)}
            e f)
          (TensorProduct.tmul.{u_1, u_2, u_3} k v w))
        (DFunLike.coe.{max (u_3 + 1) (u_4 + 1), u_3 + 1, u_4 + 1}
          (DFunLike.coe.{max (max (u_2 + 1) (u_3 + 1)) (u_4 + 1), u_2 + 1, max (u_3 + 1) (u_4 + 1)} f v) w)
